title: Projection for a proper morphism factored through an open
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, s:X→V and j:V→U with j an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and h:X→U proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] with s j=h. On the ordinary unbounded module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], use exact open extension [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact], its tensor comparison [lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor], and the counit-defined proper projections [def-kun-projection-formula-map]. For arbitrary M in D(X_et,A) and N in D(U_et,A), the canonical comparison Rs_* Jj_! ≅ Rh_* commutes with the proper/open projection maps, with coefficient transport Lh* ≅ Ls* Lj* given by the specified pullback composition isomorphism. Write E:Rs_* Jj_! ≅ Rh_* for this comparison, c_N:Lh*N→Ls*Lj*N for the pullback compositor, and δ_j^{-1}:Jj_!B⊗N→Jj_!(B⊗Lj*N). In Lean composition order, the equation is (E_M⊗1_N) ≫ π_h(M,N) ≫ Rh_*(1_M⊗c_N) = δ_j^{-1}(Rs_*M,N) ≫ Jj_!(π_s(M,Lj*N)) ≫ E_(M⊗Ls*Lj*N). No boundedness or quasi-compactness is assumed.

proof.text: The pullback tensor comparison at the identity is compatible with the canonical identity isomorphism. Use the identity case of pullback composition and its tensor-composition law, canceling the tensor comparison. This is the already proved identity_pullback_tensor in SfEtaleGraphTransferTensor. The identity extension adjunction unit is inverse to the identity extension and restriction comparisons: apply unit_leftAdjointUniq and map the resulting equality to derived categories. By the projection adjunction transpose and tensor naturality, the identity-open inverse projection followed by the canonical extension identity and the pullback identity is the tensor of the extension identity.

The square s, identity_X, j, h is Cartesian because j is a monomorphism and s j=h. Apply the already proved generic mixed_projection in CompactificationProjectionComposition (through import all), the same tensor-square calculation used by etaleProperOpenTensorSquare. It is the open tensor/base-change mate calculation using the specified adjunctions, counit projections, and open tensor/base-change identity. Postcompose with Rh_* of the identity extension comparison. Its naturality, the identity-open projection normalization, and left identity coherence for pullback composition identify the two coefficient paths. Naturality of proper projection then identifies exchange followed by identity removal with rightDerivedLowerStarCompOpenImmersionLowerShriekIso. No proper projection is inverted. The calculations are proved with a general coefficient category first and specialized to ModuleCat A, preserving instance sharing.

theorem properOpenFactor_projection
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X V U : Scheme.{u}} (s : X ⟶ V) (j : V ⟶ U) (h : X ⟶ U)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsProper h] (fac : s ≫ j = h)
    (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (N : DerivedCategoryModule A U) :
    let B := ModuleCat.{u + 1} A
    let E := rightDerivedLowerStarCompOpenImmersionLowerShriekIso A s j h fac
    ((derivedTensor B U).map (E.hom.app M)).app N ≫
        ((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap B h).app M).app N ≫
        (lowerStar B h).rightDerivedFunctor.map
          (((derivedTensor B X).obj M).map
            ((leftDerivedUpperStarComp B s j h fac.symm).hom.app N)) =
      ((derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekProjectionIso B j).inv.app
        ((lowerStar B s).rightDerivedFunctor.obj M)).app N ≫
        (openImmersionLowerShriek B j).mapDerivedCategory.map
          (((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap B s).app M).app
            ((upperStar B j).leftDerivedFunctor.obj N)) ≫
        E.hom.app (((derivedTensor B X).obj M).obj
          ((upperStar B s).leftDerivedFunctor.obj
            ((upperStar B j).leftDerivedFunctor.obj N)))
